children: The index for lettuce inflation fell a seasonally-adjusted 6.2% in August from the prior month after tumbling 16.4% in July, according to the Labor Department. The fruits and vegetables index slipped 0.4% in August.

The outbreak of cyclosporiasis, a food-borne illness believed to have sickened thousands of people, has created a lettuce crisis among Americans, some of whom have banned the item from their grocery hauls.
